data.name: AiConfirmShare
data.value:
Check the pairing code in your AI app to confirm which connection you are granting access to. Programs and chats that share this connection can use the same permission.
The AI app can read the current screen and read or search retained terminal history. This includes the normal screen behind a full-screen app and any retained output from before sharing began or while sharing was off. The bridge runs on this PC. The AI app may save the output or send it to an external model, depending on its settings.
Use End AI sharing to stop future reads. Sharing again gives the recipient access to the history still retained then.

data.name: AiConfirmControl

Check the pairing code in your AI app to confirm which connection you are granting access to. Programs and chats that share this connection can use the same permission.
